archery-world-tour.title: Archery World Tour - Play Archery Games Online for Free
archery-world-tour.slogan: Master the bow and arrow in Archery World Tour!
archery-world-tour.description: Ready to test your archery skills? Play Archery World Tour, aim for the bullseye, and become a champion. Enjoy realistic gameplay and challenge yourself in Archery World Tour now! Archery World Tour offers hours of fun for free.

HomeIframe.title: Archery World Tour
HomeIframe.description: Use your mouse to aim and fire your bow in Archery World Tour. Hold your left mouse button to draw, and release to fire. The crosshairs will slowly follow your cursor as you move your mouse. In most levels, you'll need to pay attention to the wind speed and direction if you want to hit the bullseye in Archery World Tour.

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Archery World Tour is an exciting archery simulation game where you test your skills with a bow and arrow.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use your mouse to aim your shot.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Hold the left mouse button to draw your bow.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Release the button to fire the arrow.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Experience realistic arrow flight and wind effects.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Test your skills in a variety of environments.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Master your aim to hit the bullseye every time.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Easy to learn, difficult to master gameplay.
